name: Slice and Dice
when: Slice and Dice is down at any combo points, with 6s or more of the fight left. At 5 combo points, also when it has under 3s left with over 9s of the fight left, or when [[tal:Rogue:1:18|Adrenaline Rush]] or [[tal:Rogue:1:15|Blade Flurry]] is ready and waiting for it

name: Adrenaline Rush
when: Under 39 Energy and Slice and Dice has over 1s left
notes: Adrenaline Rush anchors the big window. Low Energy wastes none of its extra regen.

name: Blade Flurry
when: Slice and Dice has over 1s left
notes: Blade Flurry is auto attack speed and does not feed the energy window, so it goes on cooldown.

name: Cold Blood
when: 5 combo points, the Energy for Eviscerate and over 6s of Slice and Dice, unless the points are going to a Slice and Dice for [[tal:Rogue:1:18|Adrenaline Rush]] or [[tal:Rogue:1:15|Blade Flurry]]
notes: The next hit spends it.

name: Eureka!
when: Slice and Dice has over 8s left
notes: For 8 sec, abilities cost 10% less and hit 10% harder.
why: Why on cooldown? This build rarely reaches a 5-point Eviscerate, so saving Eureka! for one wastes it.
